title: Your Lie in April
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Former child prodigy pianist Kosei Arima stopped being able to hear his own playing after his demanding mother died. Free-spirited violinist Kaori Miyazono drags him back into performing and competitions, while his childhood friends Tsubaki and Watari look on. Kaori is hiding a serious illness, and the story builds toward loss.
life_message: It holds up pouring yourself into art and into people while you can, even through grief.

delivery.note: Its view of art, grief and brief life is carried by Kosei's return to performing and Kaori's influence.

winners_losers: Kosei regains his music and his friends stay by him; Kaori loses her life to illness. Sympathy goes to art, honesty about grief, and love that outlasts loss.
